name: Adyen
summary: Adyen processes cards, wallets and local payment methods on one platform. Pricing is a fixed $0.13 per transaction plus a fee set by payment method, such as interchange plus scheme fees plus 0.60% for Visa and Mastercard. It lists no monthly, setup, integration or closure fees, though a minimum invoice can apply depending on industry.

facts.text: Its pricing page lists Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, ACH Direct Debit, Klarna, Affirm and other methods, each with its own fee.
Adyen's risk engine screens every payment and decides to block, allow or review it, and it is enabled by default.
After a payable batch closes, a payout can take one to two business days to be initiated, and the bank may need up to three more business days to post the funds.
Payouts equal sales minus transaction costs, refunds, chargebacks and other adjustments.
American Express in North America costs $0.13 + 3.3% + $0.10, and ACH Direct Debit costs $0.13 + $0.27.

plans.name: Visa and Mastercard

volumeFee.basis: on top of interchange and scheme fees, which Adyen passes through at cost

plans.notes: Indicative list pricing; custom pricing is available through sales

hiddenCosts: Adyen applies a minimum invoice depending on industry or business model, and the amount is not published.
Chargeback, refund and risk fees are not listed on the pricing page.
Interchange varies by card, so the all-in cost of a Visa or Mastercard payment cannot be read from the list price alone.

contract.cancellation: The pricing FAQ says there are no monthly fees, set-up fees, integration fees or closure fees.
